up: For assay CHEMBL3436042, return the exact activity values for all tested compounds. For each compound, include the canonical SMILES, the compound ChEMBL ID, the standard type, the relation, the standard value, and the standard units. The relation must be '=' for exact values.
sql:
SELECT
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  md.chembl_id,
  a.standard_type,
  a.standard_relation,
  a.standard_value,
  a.standard_units
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE
  ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3436042'
  AND a.standard_relation = '=';
